messages:
ops-kim: Seeing a spike of 5xx for requests routed to eu-west-2 since ~1882501200. Support tickets and synthetic probes both failing.
incident-bot: INC-2026-042 created (P1) for eu-west-2 request failures. Paging oncall SRE.
pagerbot: Paging @sre-alex (on-call). :rotating_light:
sre-alex: Got it, looking. Initial graphs show error-rate jump ~1882501185, latency also up. Is this across all routes or a policy subset?
ops-kim: Looks like requests that should have steered to eu-central or eu-west-1 are still going to eu-west-2 for some customers. DNS logs show long-lived A records for eu-west-2 for a subset of clients.
net-ryan: I'm seeing route-eval service returning stale decision for region key "eu-west-2" due to probe timeouts. Probable: steering policy fell back but decision cache wasn't invalidated.
eng-jordan: On it. Quick mitigation: can we temporarily lower preference for eu-west-2 in the routing policy (weight -> 0) so traffic moves off while we investigate? That avoids code deploy.
sre-alex: Agree. Preparing a manual override. Will apply a policy patch to reduce weight and increase drain TTL.
ops-kim: Heads up: customers with DNS TTL cached at edge may still hit eu-west-2 for up to 60s. Prepare comms.
sre-alex: Applied manual routing override: policy_id=latency-steer-13 set weight[euw2]=0 at 1882501270.
net-ryan: Confirmed policy change propagated to control plane. Data-plane reports still show ~30% traffic to eu-west-2 (likely DNS/edge caches).
sre-alex: Starting graceful drain on eu-west-2 hosts: 
```
# drain script
for host in $(list-euw2-hosts); do curl -X POST https://fleet/api/drain/$host || true; done
```
support-maya: Support queue update: told impacted customers we are diverting traffic and will keep them posted. Several customers reported high error rates on batch inference endpoints.
ops-kim: Any evidence of instance health issues in eu-west-2 (OOMs, GPU failures)?
eng-jordan: No OOMs. CPU and GPU healthy. Logs show our probe runner in eu-west-2 failed to fetch remote probe config at ~1882501160 and then started returning 504 on probe evaluation. That likely poisoned the routing decision cache.
net-ryan: Root cause hypothesis: probe failure -> route-eval cached last successful decision with sticky flag, combined with DNS cache TTL causing stickiness. Also saw a race where cache invalidation didn't run on probe error.
sre-alex: Rolling a hotfix to route-eval to invalidate cache on probe error (hotfix branch). Will deploy to control plane only first.
eng-jordan: Deploying hotfix (control plane) now: `kubectl -n routing rollout restart deploy/route-eval --record`
ops-kim: ETA on control-plane rollout?
eng-jordan: Started at 1882501310, pods restarting. Should be back by ~1882501340.
net-ryan: After restart, route-eval metrics show successful probe reads and cache invalidations firing. I'm seeing decision recompute events.
sre-alex: Data-plane now showing traffic shifting away from eu-west-2. Errors trending down.
sre-alex: Marking mitigation step: manual override removed at 1882501355 (restored original weights) to let steering re-evaluate with fresh probes.
ops-kim: Support reports customer error rates back to baseline, monitoring for 15m.
sre-alex: Creating short action list: 1) postmortem, 2) add cache-invalidation unit test, 3) add probe failure alert, 4) adjust default DNS TTL guidance for customers.
sre-alex: From oncall: will hand off to eng-jordan and net-ryan for the hotfix follow-up and postmortem.
eng-jordan: I'll own the code fix and tests. net-ryan will own rollout plan and verification.
sre-alex: Handoff: I'm leaving the incident channel at 1882501375. If anything regresses, re-page me.
sre-alex: Final check: error rates down to baseline, latency stable. Closing paging window.
incident-bot: INC-2026-042 status -> mitigated. Postmortem assigned to eng-jordan.
support-maya: Sending final customer updates now. Thanks team. :heart:
ops-kim: Quick note for postmortem: include timeline of DNS cache impact and estimate of customer TTL exposure.
eng-jordan: Will include. Adding timeline and conftest snippets.
net-ryan: I'll draft follow-up runbook entry for probe-failure handling and cache invalidation steps.
ops-kim: Great. End of thread at 1882501389.
